# Nehemiah Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 470v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-words [divrey] of-Nechemyah son of-Chakhalyah. And-it-was in-the-month of-Kislev, in-the-twentieth year [shanah], and-I was in-Shushan the-fortress [ha-birah].

**1:2** And-came Chanani, one of-my-brothers, he and-men from-Yehudah, and-I-asked them concerning the-Yehudim [ha-Yehudim] the-remnant [ha-peletah] who had-survived from-the-captivity [ha-shevi], and-concerning Yerushalayim.

**1:3** And-they-said to-me, "The-remnant who are-left from-the-captivity there in-the-province [ha-medinah] are in-great evil [ra'ah gedolah] and-in-reproach [cherpah], and-the-wall [chomat] of-Yerushalayim is-broken-down [meforatset], and-its-gates [she'areyha] are-consumed [nitsetu] with-fire [ba-esh]."

**1:4** And-it-was when-I-heard [ke-shom'i] these words, I-sat-down and-wept and-mourned [va-etabel] days [yamim], and-I-was fasting [tsom] and-praying [mitpalel] before the-God [Elohey] of-the-heavens [ha-shamayim].

**1:5** And-I-said, "I-beseech-you [anna], YHWH, God of-the-heavens, the-God the-great [ha-gadol] and-the-fearsome [ve-ha-nora], who-keeps the-covenant [ha-berit] and-the-covenant-faithfulness [chesed] for-those-who-love-him and-for-those-who-keep his-commandments [mitsvotav]:

**1:6** Let-be, please, your-ear [oznekha] attentive [qashevet] and-your-eyes [einekha] open [petuchot], to-hear [lishmo'a] the-prayer [tefilat] of-your-servant [avdekha] which I am-praying [mitpalel] before-you today [ha-yom], day [yomam] and-night [va-laylah], concerning the-sons of-Yisra'el your-servants, and-confessing [u-mitvadeh] over the-sins [chatot] of-the-sons of-Yisra'el which we-have-sinned [chatanu] against-you; both-I and-the-house of-my-father have-sinned.

**1:7** We-have-acted-very-corruptly [chabol chavalnu] against-you, and-we-have-not-kept the-commandments [ha-mitsvot] and-the-statutes [ha-chuqqim] and-the-judgments [ha-mishpatim] which you-commanded [tsivvita] Mosheh your-servant.

**1:8** Remember [zekhor], please, the-word which you-commanded Mosheh your-servant, saying, 'If-you act-unfaithfully [tim'alu ma'al], I will-scatter-you [afits etkhem] among-the-peoples [ba-ammim].

**1:9** But-if-you-return [va-shavtem] to-me and-keep my-commandments and-do them — if-your-outcasts [niddachakem] are at-the-end of-the-heavens [bi-qtseh ha-shamayim], from-there I-will-gather-them [aqabbetsem] and-bring-them to-the-place [ha-maqom] which I-have-chosen [bacharti] to-cause-my-name [shemi] to-dwell [le-shakkein] there.'

**1:10** And-they are-your-servants and-your-people whom you-have-redeemed [padita] by-your-great power [be-kokhakha ha-gadol] and-by-your-strong hand [u-ve-yadekha ha-chazaqah].

**1:11** I-beseech-you [anna], Lord [Adonay], let-be, please, your-ear attentive to-the-prayer of-your-servant and-to-the-prayer of-your-servants who-delight [ha-chafetsim] to-fear [le-yir'ah] your-name, and-cause-to-prosper [ve-hatslach], please, for-your-servant today [ha-yom], and-give-him [u-tenehu] compassion [le-rachamim] before [lifney] this man [ha-ish ha-zeh]." And-I was cupbearer [mashqeh] to-the-king [la-melekh].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **1:1 "Shushan the-fortress"** — The Hebrew *birah* denotes a fortified citadel or palace complex, not merely a city. Susa served as the winter capital of the Persian Empire.
2. **1:5 "covenant-faithfulness" (chesed)** — This term carries covenantal weight beyond mere "kindness"; it implies YHWH's binding loyalty to His covenant partners.
3. **1:8-9 Deuteronomic echo** — Nehemiah's prayer directly alludes to Deuteronomy 30:1-4, invoking the covenant curses and restoration promises given through Moses.
4. **1:11 "cupbearer" (mashqeh)** — A high-ranking court official who tasted the king's wine; this position gave Nehemiah direct access to Artaxerxes I.

*— EMET*
